text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
Happy New Year, Jordan!
Wanna go grab some burgers?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Sorry, can't today!
13, 14... 15!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Off again~.
Like, isn't aiming for exactly 15 seconds way too awkward?

text_block_list.name: Classmate A
text_block_list.text:
No. Rather,
what are you doing? With that.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
...I'm having a showdown with Trainer right now!
If I can time 15 seconds on the dot...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: They said they'd take me to a super high-end all-you-can-eat buffet!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Starting this year, it's the Classic division.
Until last year in the Junior division, her opponents were "racing beginners,"
but this year is different.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
More and more girls get used to their awakened bodies,
understand how to handle races and their own aptitudes,
and head into the real competitions.
choice_data_list: (I need to help forge a weapon that is uniquely hers...)

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: "For that reason, I incorporated a two-stage training regimen designed to make her mindful of the clock."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: For Step 1, a stopwatch to make it feel like a game so it blends seamlessly into daily life. And for Step 2—

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: (RATTLE-CLATTER!)

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: 'Sup~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So about this morning's match, can you three take on the challenge?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: You're definitely treating me to the all-you-can-eat, got it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ehh, we're running~?!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"The key to this Step 2 is how well
you can sharpen your internal clock."

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: In an actual race, a runner's internal clock is vital for determining whether the pace is fast or slow.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"That is precisely why I want to hone her internal clock.
If she can adjust how she launches her final spurt to match the race development, then..."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: That's not what you said! You told me it'd be fine as long as I counted exactly 15 seconds...
choice_data_list: Counting 15 seconds in your head is the same, right?
Counting 15 seconds in your head is the same, isn't it?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Hm? Come to think of it...?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, 15 seconds! I'm gonna do it!
Time me, okay!? Ready... set...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: One, two... three, four...

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Tosen Jordan started running while counting out loud.
Her time for one furlong—200 meters—was—

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text: Ooooh!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah... Way too early...!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
"Perhaps the stopwatch training had shown some results.
Just as I was feeling proud of her growth—"

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Whoa, sick! Looks so fun~☆
Gimme a shot at it too!!

text_block_list.name: Mejiro Palmer
text_block_list.text: Me too! Let me try just once!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Alright, then the three of us are getting our revenge!
Let's do this!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Yaaaaaaaaaah!!

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text: And all three of them ended up running side by side. The result was—

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text:
All right!
Pien...
Dammit...!
choice_data_list: Why has this turned into a race?!
Why has this turned into a race?!

text_block_list.name: The Three
text_block_list.text: Huh?

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
The awareness of 'running in 15 seconds' that they held earlier
had completely slipped the minds of all three of them.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah, well, competing gets me hyped anyway?
Can't be helped, right?
choice_data_list: I'll keep that in mind next time...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Mm. 'Sup.

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
Even so, she seriously engaged with
the challenge I set for her in her own way...
choice_data_list: Wanna go to an all-you-can-eat buffet?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: !? Seriously!?
choice_data_list: It's not ultra-luxurious or anything, but...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Nah, it's totally fine, totally fine♪
C'mon, hurry up and take me along♪

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: So, where are we going?
choice_data_list: Savor the New Year! All-You-Can-Eat Osechi

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ooh, you totally get it.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
My heart fluttered a bit.
Like, by 2 millimeters. Or maybe that was my stomach?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: You're just hungry☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Tadaaa~☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's hurry up and go...

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text: Sushi!? Sweet!!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
I get it! Wait, seriously?
Trainer, are you a genius or what?

text_block_list.name: Both
text_block_list.text:
"Sushiii~♪
Sushi, sushiii~♪"

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's hurry up and go...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Fo' real? Osechi, huh.
You heading over to your grandma's or something?

text_block_list.name: Daitaku Helios
text_block_list.text:
Then wanna go to my grandma's place?
She'll give us a big welcome!

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Fo' real!?
choice_data_list: I'd feel bad accepting, so let's just go to a restaurant.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Aha, you breakin' a sweat? Priceless.
Trainer, you're way too serious~.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Anyway, let's hurry up and go...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah... Nah, never mind?
Go on ahead to the school gate. I'll be there in a sec.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Ugh. Peeling off again...

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: Jordan? What are you doing?

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
Ah! Um... a nail tip came off, see?
So I was just putting it back on.

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text: ...Again? Maybe the hoof itself is getting weak...

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Ah. It's fine, it's fine! Just using super weak adhesive tape.

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text:
So if you find any good tapes next time,
pwease wet me know☆

text_block_list.name: Gold City
text_block_list.text:
"I'll ask the makeup artist next time.
For something gentle that won't strain your scalp much."

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: ...Teehee☆

text_block_list.name: Tosen Jordan
text_block_list.text: Thanks, City.
